artifact_note: Built from this tree with ./build-dist-zip.sh at head_commit. SHA256SUMS covers it. pre-release-candidates/ is excluded from the artifact by .distignore and by the build's hard deny list, so none of these folders can ride along into a ZIP.

assembled_from.opencode-big-pickle: no-hedge method pair and the method_exists guards
assembled_from.grok-4-6: public request protection, IVR greeting variables, line-break forms, Public Title placement

verification.journey_harness: DEFERRED — needs WP-CLI on the target site
verification.contract_acceptance: DEFERRED — personality built from scratch, attached to a pack, carrying that flow to its outcome

designer_pass.note: The DA1 AI Personality Designer, made usable. Version held at 8.0.0.
designer_pass.one_card: A wellspring is an aspect; a category is a group of aspects; both are the same card. Drop an aspect onto a card and that card becomes the heading it sits under, keeping density, gain, binding, hue, star and trajectory.
designer_pass.group_noun: heading | wellspring | cloud | rain cloud | pool | category — defaults from density: cloud in soul, rain cloud in character, pool in behavior.
designer_pass.nested_density: 16 inside 95 reads 95.016; 100 inside 95 reads 95.100. Any depth. Derived, never stored. Ties sort alphabetically.
designer_pass.dialogs_removed: Both <dialog> blocks opened a <form> inside WordPress's settings form. The browser dropped the inner tag, #tribForm was null, and the listener on it threw — killing every line of setup after it, which is why + Category did nothing.
designer_pass.placement_round_trip: workshopFile() wrote placement and importSpec() never read it. It does now, so a group survives a save.
designer_pass.soul_section: Shown on every card, read from the placement rather than recalculated. Default is the last heading at or below the card's density.
designer_pass.trajectory_posts: 412, ?post=412, or a permalink resolves to that post's title and excerpt. Boot list from flosc_personality_trajectory_posts().
